reviewScope: Q056-Q080; all 25 complete round-10 captured responses and returned citation bundles

Responses were compared with the official service pages and full policy/document passages inspected during this same-day review, including rendered policy, lending-table, handbook and document-guide pages. An attempted repeat web-tool fetch of AE04 timed out; the complete same-day official PDF inspection remains the grading evidence. Record-level references are not a formal claim-entailment proof. Historical policy supersession has not been certified. No captured answer was changed.
